bio: Elegant & classic, the County Hotel is the perfect place to enjoy your Afternoon Tea experience. Choose from two Afternoon Tea offerings- traditionalists can enjoy the Classic Afternoon Tea and those craving something creative can opt for The Best of the British Afternoon Tea.  The Classic Afternoon Tea will delight those craving a quintessential treat. Indulge in an array of beautiful finger sandwiches, house-made delicate cakes & sweet treats, savouries and freshly baked house-made scones.  The Great British Afternoon is the County Hotel's take on British savouries including Spicy Coronation Chicken Sandwich, Carrot Cake and Mini Fish & Chips. The 'Best of British' menu will be served along with their Classic Afternoon Tea menu, so it's decision time- is it Goodbye Cucumber... Hello Roast Beef?  The County Hotel is located 3 minutes from the train & bus station and a 10 minute walk from the city centre. Many popular tourist destinations are within walking distance of the hotel.
